notes.text: The page continues a discussion of the simplicial maquette associated with nonempty intersections D_J. The author asks “quelle est sa signification topologique?” and connects components with D=X\setminus U and the completed neighborhood minus D. He then considers the hypothetical infinity-connectedness of the nonempty D_J, explicitly says that this is not the case except for a stratum reduced to a point, and asks whether the maquette could express the homotopy type of U_infty. This is a report of his question and hypothetical argument, not a theorem verification.

The source still reads “connexes correspondent comp. connexes” without independent aux/les, and “le l’ombre complété”. The long q descender at the first gap is not a short word. The quoted noun remains compactification/complification/complétification. A detached mark after the first cancelled noun is now retained as a doubtful comma; its function remains uncertain.

Equation (37) is presented as an exact sequence with first term T^J, an E object over U_J carrying barred L, an E object over D_J carrying a cancelled exponent, and terminal 1. The first arrow remains hook/to uncertain. The adjacent note continues “plutot/plutôt ou/en ci-contre)” and its closing curve is not a prime on J; no missing opening parenthesis is supplied. The single T^J belongs to the displayed sequence and is not duplicated in the note.

The continuation chooses a universal cover of D_J and speaks of a universal cover of X_J by inverse image, then defines the function field tilde L_J. “Par image inverse” is raised and carried by one continuous curved leader; neither of the parentheses supplied by both witnesses is independent ink. The relation between tilde X_J and tilde U_J is visibly dot–dash-like and remains uncertain. Alg sép is inserted after ext.; no separate stops are secure.

The rotated upper note now securely reads “tubes étales”. The lower quoted note retains “au dessus de bar K”. The NB block remains difficult: its opening admits Il faut partir or a tilde-U_J fait partie reading. The first visible U_J has no securely independent barred K index; the former si on veut is replaced by a doubtful short cluster i.e. A small open rounded cover symbol is now read C_0 / tilde V_0 under doubt. These local uncertainties prevent treating the entire note as a verified mathematical construction. Main-text strokes crossing the oblique lines are not additional marginal words or indices.

The handwritten page number is 66, the sequence number is (37), the sequence ends in the digit 1, the doubtful NB symbol C_0 / tilde V_0 has a low oval read as 0, and the separate lower marginal foliation is 132. The scan identifier and H editorial markers are not handwritten source text.

The page was read visually from the complete image and the two supplied native halves, then from saved crops of word disagreements, resolved doubts, cancellations and crowded formulas. There are 26 main baselines including the displayed sequence, excluding interlinear insertions and oblique margins. No OCR, external research, TeX compilation, proof check or computation was performed; check_events is therefore empty.

The blind audit withdrew overconfident readings where the t entry had been mistaken for an accent (etalement) and where oblique main/marginal crossings suggested extra letters. It also restored the ci-contre continuation. No claim of consistency is inferred from the unresolved NB cover symbol, and no external mathematical source was used.

audit_changes.evidence: This broad rotated crop includes neighboring notes and main-text strokes. In the NB block the opening resembles Il faut partir but the joined initial body and low hook also admit the independent reader's tilde-U_J fait partie; it cannot remain wholly certain. After de the first U has a clear hooked J; the supposed barred K and si on veut are not recoverable as separate letters from the crossing façon/précise strokes. The surviving small short-form cluster is compatible with i.e. and remains doubtful. The small cover-symbol body has a rounded open C-like curve and low oval rather than a clear V point; no independent tilde is secure there. The later U_Jalpha, qu'on va, the uncertain multiplier, au dessus de barred K, bien sûr, d'où, and the tilded X/D clusters can be followed, with their previous local doubts retained. The foliation, equation tag and other two notes in this wide box are not duplicated.
